leakage_audit_findings.train_test_split: 80/20 Stratified on Valuation Tier (40 Train / 10 Test)
leakage_audit_findings.discretization_protocol: Quantiles fitted strictly on X_train only; X_test binned with train thresholds
leakage_audit_findings.encoding_protocol: OneHotEncoder fitted strictly on X_train; handle_unknown='ignore' safely handles test categories

prior_leaky_pipeline.issue: pd.qcut and pd.get_dummies fitted globally prior to split, causing quantile leakage and phantom category column.

audited_leak_free_pipeline.benefit: Strict separation between train and test distributions with robust generalization (+10% test accuracy gain).

key_probabilistic_decision_rules: IF Price_Tier_Med AND Tenure_Tier_Med THEN Valuation is High (Class Prior: 0.33)
IF Tenure_Tier_Low AND Price_Tier_High THEN Valuation is Low (Class Prior: 0.35)
IF League_NFL AND Price_Tier_Low THEN Valuation is Med (Class Prior: 0.33)

collinear_pruning.rationale: Year_Purchased_Clean is mathematically collinear (r=-1.0) with Years_Held; pruning prevents artificial 2x distortion of the ownership tenure dimension in Euclidean space.

agnes_clustering_audit.optimal_k_justification: k=3 achieves the optimal macro-cluster cohesion (silhouette=0.3764) while yielding 3 clear, strategically distinct franchise investment archetypes. Although k=5 yields a silhouette of 0.4214, it fragments the dataset into micro-clusters (sizes 4, 4), destroying macroeconomic interpretability.

cluster_archetypes.1: Recent High-Capital Takeovers (Short Tenure ~6 yrs, High Purchase Price ~$2.2B, Private Equity/Billionaire Ownership)
cluster_archetypes.2: Hyper-Growth Outliers & Modern Powerhouses (10.8 yrs tenure, 173.8% 5-Yr Growth, Global Media Reach)
cluster_archetypes.3: Historic Blue-Chip Franchises (Long Tenure ~33.7 yrs, Historic Low Acquisition Cost ~$334M, Massive Compounded Value)
